nora: quick spike — how interruptible should automatic fallback be for in-flight requests? thinking UX + audit implications. :thinking_face:
jun: by interruptible you mean allowing the fallback to cancel an ongoing higher-tier request mid-stream?
priya: yes — oncall concern: cancel mid-stream can leave partial outputs to clients, we need clear semantics and a way to mark responses as partial/aborted.
marco: backend note: KV cache + streaming make cancels tricky. if we kill a request mid-token we must ensure no corrupt cache state. we can add a safe cutpoint at chunk boundaries.
sam: telemetry: we should emit an event for every interrupt attempt with trace_id and decision_reason. sampling ok, but must retain full context for errors > threshold.
jun: propose API flag and UI toggle: `interruptible: true|false` and action enum `on_interrupt: cancel|graceful_degrade|continue_with_variant`.
marco: implementation plan — `cancel` will send an abort to runtime; `graceful_degrade` will let current sentence finish then switch model for subsequent tokens; `continue_with_variant` means fallback model picks up from KV cache if compatible.
priya: what about quotas/retries? cancelled requests shouldn't double-bill but will count towards quota. need policy decision.
nora: UX idea: console shows a pill for active rollouts: "Interrupts allowed" / "No interrupts". tooltip explains user-visible effects and billing implications.
sam: suggested telemetry names: `fallback.decision`, `fallback.interrupt_attempt`, `fallback.interrupt_result` (success|partial|failed). include sampling rate in policy metadata.
jun: config snippet prototype:
```
rollout_policy:
  fallback_mode: automatic
  interruptible: true
  on_interrupt: graceful_degrade
  audit:
    sampling: 0.05
    capture_traces_on_error_rate: 0.02
```
priya: runbook: if interrupt rate spikes > 2% for 5m, open incident, auto-toggle interrupts off for that customer. we need console toggle and API override.
nora: short UX copy draft for tooltip: "If enabled, the platform may interrupt higher-tier model calls and switch to fallback models during rollouts. This can reduce latency/cost but may produce partial outputs. Audited at 5% by default."
marco: low-level: need a handshake so fallback can claim a stream only when runtime confirms state transfer (kv/offset). otherwise `graceful_degrade` isn't safe.
sam: I lean default sampling 5% and full capture (logs+trace) when a client sees an error or when interrupt_result==partial.
jun: agree. also API should expose `last_interrupt_reason` and a breadcrumb trace id in response headers for audit.
priya: +1 for telemetry + runbook. need to check billing edgecases with finance.
nora: thanks — action items: (1) jun/marco draft API + runtime handshake, (2) sam defines telemetry events + default sample, (3) priya + ops write escalation runbook, (4) i'll mock console toggle + tooltip copy and put in Figma. anyone want to take ownership? :raised_hands:
jun: i'll take API + handshake.
marco: runtime work from me.
sam: telemetry defs i'll own.
priya: ops runbook handled.
deploy-bot: deploy: staging rollout-policy-ui v0.8 deployed by ci-bot — 2023-11-22T14:02:13Z :rocket:
nora: great — i'll add the UX mock to the thread when ready. :eyes:
